limitations: Proposed only; software-lead adoption and exact capture contract pending upperbody#35/#37.
State descriptors do not authorize learned-policy commands. No real lift ROS command interface; mock/Gazebo lift_controller only.
Arm/gripper command capture topics, Device Package conversion/signs and physical validation need owner review. Arm/gripper/lift ranges are generated-model bounds; unknown base ranges remain null.
16 values may also be two Cartesian poses; dimensionality never establishes representation. Require explicit qpos columns, order and units.
17-channel source is two qpos arms/grippers plus lifter/elevation; this does not supply base.
lift_positioning phase requires time-aligned base stopped and reviewed stowed-arm evidence; park is a placeholder.
Accepted C9 v1 sidecar unchanged; this profile is a separately versioned additive descriptor, never a training authorization.
